_note: Guide picks. Each perk, Relic perk and cyberware name must exist in the pulled wiki data, and each perk must come after the perk it needs (build.py checks both). The attribute plan, perk effects, cyberware effects and matching iconic weapons are filled in from the data at build time. Which recent creator videos name each pick is computed from their titles and descriptions.

builds.name: Netrunner
builds.answer: Hack from cover with a cyberdeck: Intelligence to 20 for the RAM and Overclock perks, Technical Ability for cyberware, a point in Cool for crouched defence.

play.t: Install a cyberdeck such as [[NetWatch Netdriver]]: it lets you quickhack enemies and devices while scanning.
Open each fight from cover with [[Ping]]: it reveals enemies and devices connected to the local network.
Queue more than one quickhack on a target once you have [[Hack Queue]] and [[Queue Acceleration]] (each gives +1 Max RAM, the cyberdeck resource that every quickhack costs).
When RAM runs out, activate [[Overclock]]: for 14 sec. you can keep hacking and each RAM unit over your max costs 10 Health; the cooldown is 30 sec.

builds.name: Blades and Sandevistan
builds.answer: Close in fast and cut with katanas, knives or Mantis Blades: Reflexes to 20 for the blade and dash perks, Body for Adrenaline Rush, a Sandevistan to slow time.

play.t: Install a Sandevistan such as [[Militech Apogee]]: it slows time by 85% while you are not slowed (max duration 6 sec.).
Activate the Sandevistan on demand when a fight starts; since [[Patch 2.0]], pressing the activation button again mid-usage stops it early.
Dash toward enemies: [[Mad Dash]] gives +100% Dash range toward enemies.
Block bullets with a blade while your Stamina is above 33%: [[Bullet Deflect]] deflects them.
Finish weakened enemies with [[Finisher: Bladerunner]].
Use the +25% Movement Speed and Attack Speed from [[Flash Of Steel]] to reach the next enemy.

builds.name: Pistols and revolvers
builds.answer: Aim for the head with pistols and revolvers: Cool to 20 for the Deadeye perks, Reflexes for shooting on the move, Technical Ability for cyberware.

play.t: Aim down sights for headshots: [[Focus]] gives +10% Headshot and Weakspot damage.
Keep killing while Focus is active: with [[Head To Head]], a ranged kill resets its duration.
If you want two guns at once, buy [[Double Trouble]]: it unlocks dual wield for Power Pistols and Power Revolvers only, and each weapon deals −37.5% damage.
Install [[Kerenzikov]]: it lets you aim and perform ranged attacks while sliding, dodging or Dashing.

builds.name: Stealth and throwing knives
builds.answer: Stay unseen and kill with knives, axes and silenced guns: Cool to 20 for Ninjutsu and the throwing perks, Optical Camo, Intelligence 9 for trace protection.

play.t: Stay out of combat for the bonus: [[Killer Instinct]] gives +25% damage with knives, axes and silenced guns outside of combat.
Crouch to move: [[Feline Footwork]] gives +15% Movement Speed and +15% Mitigation Chance when crouched.
Equip [[Optical Camo]]: −30-90% visibility to enemies for 4-7 sec.
If you are spotted, pop camo in combat: the Relic perk [[Emergency Cloaking]] makes enemies lose track of you (Optical Camo must be in the Combat Gadget quickslot).

builds.name: Tank: shotguns, Gorilla Arms and Berserk
builds.answer: This build fights up close: shotguns, plus Gorilla Arms while Berserk is active. Body to 20 for Adrenaline Rush and the shotgun perks, Technical Ability to 20 for Edgerunner and more cyberware.

play.t: Buy [[Painkiller]] first: it unlocks slow Health regen in combat.
Fight at low Stamina on purpose: [[Die! Die! Die!]] gives +12.5% Crit Chance at low Stamina with Shotguns, LMGs and HMGs.
Install [[Second Heart]]: +100% Health when your Health reaches 0.
When you are surrounded, activate [[Militech Berserk]]: while it is active you are invulnerable to all damage, but you can use melee weapons only and no items.
Fight with [[Gorilla Arms]] while Berserk is active.
